title: test(runtime): pin the api action door's 2xx reading of a { success: false } answer
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27918

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no behaviour changes; no skill or doc describes how this door reads a 2xx body

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`type: 'api'` 动作转发门对目标 2xx 答复的读法保持原样,只把它钉住:docblock 写明"2xx 一律按成功读,不看 body 的 success",并加了单元测试 + 一个门级测试。
- **为什么改**:分诊要求先实测。逐一核对仓内每个同源 `type: 'api'` 动作目标后,没有任何一个会以 2xx 答顶层 `success: false`(拒绝全部是非 2xx),所以按分诊结论"钉住现状并关卡"。
- **风险与回滚**:零运行时风险:生产代码只改了注释,其余是测试。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`(`apiActionResultOf` 的 docblock,实测清单的结论在这里)→ `packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`(新增 4 个用例)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`,预期 29 passed。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Measure-first, per triage 6515335719. **No same-origin `type: 'api'` target in this repository answers HTTP 2xx with a top-level `success: false`**, so today's reading is pinned rather than changed:

- `apiActionResultOf` docblock: a 2xx is read as success whatever its body says, and why (the measured fact, plus "a target that starts answering that shape has the defect itself; the remedy goes in that target, never a body check here").
- `api-action-forward.test.ts`: a door-level case through `handleActions` (200 `{ success: false, data }` → 200 `data`; 200 `{ success: false, message }` → 200 with the body as `data`) and three unit cases through the real `apiActionResultOf` export.

No production behaviour changes. `skip-changeset`: the only `src` edit is a comment (fast lane).

## Acceptance notes

<details><summary>The measured census (tree: objectstack-ai/objectstack @ 5f6dc96c3, re-read after merging main @ 4a5396b81)</summary>

Declarations: `git grep -nE "type:\s*['\"]api['\"]"` outside tests/dist/docs = 244 hits; the action declarations among them name **77 targets** across `packages/platform-objects` (58, all `sys_*` identity actions), `plugin-approvals` (9), `service-datasource` (2, metadata-type actions), `examples/app-showcase` (4), and `ui/` (1 dev harness + 3 grid demos on `/api/demo/*`, which no server serves). JSON/YAML metadata: 0 action declarations. Dogfood fixtures: one test-injected target, `/api/v1/cloud/organizations/{id}/change-slug`, served by the cloud repo (out of this tree).

Routes those targets resolve to, and what each answers on a refusal:

| Target family | Route owner | `success: false` sites | 2xx `success: false`? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `/api/v1/auth/**` objectstack mounts (admin/*, sso/*, sys-session/revoke, sys-oauth-application/register, organization add-member, send-verification-email …) | `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/*` | 100 hits; every one carries a literal 4xx/5xx, or a status derived from a vendor `!resp.ok` / a thrown error's status (`mapAuthApiError`, `resolveThrownHttpError`) | none |
| `/api/v1/auth/**` stock better-auth routes | `better-auth@1.7.12` dist | non-`true` `success` only on `/organization/has-permission` and `/admin/has-permission` (`{ error: null, success: bool }` at 200) | none targeted: no declared action names either route |
| `/api/v1/approvals/requests/{id}/*` (9) | `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts` | `res.json(out)` relays the service result; `ApprovalDecisionResult` / `Recall` / `SendBack` / `Resubmit` / `{ request }` carry no `success` key; refusals go through `handleApprovalError` / 4xx-5xx | none |
| `/api/v1/datasources/:name/test`, `/migrate-credential` | `packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts:762,786` | `sendOk` → `{ success: true, data }` always | none |
| `/api/v1/keys` | `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts` | 1 (the 405) | none |
| `/api/v1/data/sys_api_key/{id}` (PATCH) | `packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts` | `deps.success` / `deps.error` | none |
| `/api/v1/apps/showcase/recalc` (flow endpoint) | `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts` | classified refusals → 4xx; the unclassified residual answers 200 `{ success: true, data: { success: false } }`, and the engine's one unclassified exit (flow not found) is pre-probed to 404 | none at top level |
| `/api/v1/print/records`, `/api/v1/forms/:slug/submit` | `service-print/src/print-routes.ts`, `rest/src/form-routes.ts` | 0; `sendError` / mapped status | none |

Nested `{ success: true, data: { success: false } }` answers (flow residual, a zero-row `DELETE /data`, a package rollback) come back through this door as the same bytes: unwrap `data`, re-wrap with `deps.success`. No live probe was run: the code read is not ambiguous for any row.
</details>

- **Ride-along not made (deviation).** The card asked to reword the `actions.ts` ledger note in `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` ("the non-2xx relay (`deps.error` spread)") "after PR #27915". #27915 is an open draft that has not merged, and on `main` the non-2xx relay still goes through `deps.error` spread (`actions.ts:851`), so the note is accurate today. Rewording it here would make it wrong on `main`. The rewording belongs to #27915, which changes that code.
- `git merge-tree` against the three open PRs that touch these files (#27964, #27940, #27915): all merge clean.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the test imports `../action-execution.js`, so src, no dist)</summary>

1. Door reads a 2xx `success: false` as a refusal: `actions.ts` `if (answer.status >= 200 && answer.status < 300) {` → `… && (answer.body as any)?.success !== false) {`. Mutation landed (anchor 1→0, blob da0ea3439e21→0967d680dd2b). **Red**: `Tests 1 failed | 28 passed (29)`, `relays a 2xx { success: false, … } answer as a 200 result` → `expected false to be true`. Restored: blob after == HEAD (da0ea3439e21).
2. Unwrap skips a `success: false` body: `'data' in body && 'success' in body` → `'data' in body && (body as any).success !== false`. Landed (a809a3f76e9d→ec5627410e23). **Red**: `Tests 2 failed | 27 passed (29)`: the door case and the `{ success: false, data }` unit case, `expected { success: false, …(1) } to deeply equal { reason: 'already_banned' }`. Restored: blob after == HEAD (a809a3f76e9d).
</details>
